name.en-US: The Holy Blissful Martyr Saint Thomas of Canterbury
name.pt-BR: O Santo Bem-aventurado Mártir São Tomás de Cantuária

description.en-US: Benson's short life of St Thomas Becket (1910) for the Westminster Library: his birth, youth and rise, the chancellor and archbishop, the troubles in England, exile and return, and his passion, death and coronation in glory.
description.pt-BR: A breve vida de São Tomás Becket por Benson (1910), para a Westminster Library: nascimento, juventude e ascensão, o chanceler e arcebispo, os problemas na Inglaterra, o exílio e o regresso, e sua paixão, morte e coroação na glória.

sources.edition: The Holy Blissful Martyr Saint Thomas of Canterbury (London: Sands & Co., 1910), Internet Archive full-text OCR (holyblissfulmart00bensuoft).
sources.description: Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Mgr. Robert Hugh Benson died in 1914 and the edition is of 1910, so the text is public domain.
